title: Keypad Dialing
blurb: Four quick telephone keypad tones — real DTMF frequencies, the actual dual-tone system phones use to dial. It's the sound of urgently calling someone in every movie ever made. Use it in edits before a phone-call scene, in podcasts as a transition, or anywhere you need instant we're-making-a-call energy. Synthesized to spec, so it's clean, original, and free to use.
origin: Genuine DTMF dual-tone synthesis — the same frequencies real phones dial with.
